optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

professionalSummary.text: Senior data engineer with two years of experience building and maintaining telemetry‑work‑order pipelines for industrial equipment maintenance analytics.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks)

experienceHighlights.text: Designed and implemented an hourly Spark pipeline that integrates vibration and temperature telemetry with work‑order history, handling late‑arrival data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained and versioned the failure‑prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) used by the planning team’s model.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the failure‑prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated schema and feature changes with planning and platform teams, ensuring approvals in fortnightly data reviews.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented data lineage and known limitations for the telemetry‑work‑order join pipeline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Feature‑set change log and telemetry‑work‑order lineage note, including Databricks job identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the feature-set change log for one quarter and the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, with the Databricks job identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Apache Spark, Databricks, ETL pipeline development, feature engineering, data lineage documentation, cross‑team coordination.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience in building telemetry‑work‑order pipelines, maintaining failure‑prediction features, coordinating schema changes, and documenting lineage. They do not provide direct evidence of measurable improvement in early‑failure capture rates attributable solely to the candidate.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has sufficient evidence for most technical requirements but lacks direct evidence of measurable improvement in early‑failure capture rates.

role.roleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

evidence.text: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.
evidence.notes: Direct description of pipeline construction and integration.

evidence.text: Maintained the failure‑prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

Candidate said the planning team told him the model 'now catches about two thirds of failures early, up from maybe half'; he said the numbers were the planning team's, that he had not seen the evaluation, and that several other changes were made to the model in the same period.
evidence.notes: No direct attribution or independent verification.

missingEvidence: Independent evaluation of early‑failure capture rate before and after candidate’s interventions; documentation of candidate’s specific contributions to the improvement.

evidence.text: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.

supportedClaims.witness: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

supportedClaims.claim: Maintained the failure‑prediction feature set consumed by the planning team’s model.
supportedClaims.witness: Maintained the failure‑prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

supportedClaims.claim: Coordinated schema and feature changes with planning and platform teams.
supportedClaims.witness: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

supportedClaims.claim: Documented data lineage and known limitations for the telemetry‑work‑order join pipeline.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.
